description: Source code for the BalsaFrame class, part of the quiche HTTP/3 implementation, handling HTTP message parsing including headers, body, chunked transfer encoding, and trailers.

classes.name: BalsaFrame
classes.description: Handles parsing of HTTP messages, including headers, body, chunked transfer encoding, trailers, and state management.

classes.name: HeaderLineDescription
classes.description: Describes a header line with indices for key and value within the header stream.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the BalsaFrame object for parsing a new message.

methods.name: ProcessFirstLine
methods.description: Parses the first line of an HTTP request or response and updates headers and state accordingly.

methods.name: ProcessHeaderLines
methods.description: Processes header lines, extracting key-value pairs, handling special headers like content-length and transfer-encoding.

methods.name: AssignParseStateAfterHeadersHaveBeenParsed
methods.description: Determines the next parsing state after headers are processed, based on headers and message type.

methods.name: ProcessHeaders
methods.description: Parses the headers section of an HTTP message, handling header lines, errors, and special headers.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Main entry point for processing incoming data, managing state transitions and invoking header/body parsing.

methods.name: BytesSafeToSplice
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes safe to splice into the current message buffer based on the current parse state.

methods.name: BytesSpliced
methods.description: Updates internal state after a certain number of bytes have been spliced into the message buffer.

methods.name: CheckHeaderLinesForInvalidChars
methods.description: Checks header lines for invalid characters.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Handles parsing errors, setting error state and notifying the visitor.
